Minimax H3 的严肃高水平 T2V / I2V / FFLF / REF2V 工作流程具有大量选项和可切换的生活质量功能。

  • 在[T2V / I2V / FFLF]模型和[REF2VA]模型之间轻松切换

  • 添加了强制自定义音频：T2V/I2V/REF2VA 现在可以轻松地将口型同步到自定义对话/音乐！

  • 时间上采样器第二遍选项！ [https://github.com/matlowai/ComfyUI-MAINodes]

  • 新的图像加载器允许直接在节点内裁剪/设置最大百万像素：https://github.com/obvpm/comfyui-obvpm （必须通过解压缩到 custom_nodes 文件夹或通过 comfy-manager 的 Install via Git 选项进行安装，它太新了，无法出现在 comfy-manager 的索引中）

  • Kijai 的预览覆盖（放置https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/blob/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors在 /vae_approx/ 中并设置为非像素化预览的自定义 vae）

  • 加速：Sage-Attn + 新的 Sol-Attn [https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton]

  • 加速节点：EasyCache / Spectrum [https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3]

  • Turbo LoRA（t2v/i2v，但如果您不介意[一些]音频质量下降，则可与 ref2va 配合使用）

    • 新 (8/11/26) Lightx2v 1.0 发布 [https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/tree/main]

  • 电影 VFI 帧插值 (24 fps -> 48 fps)

  • 轻松切换参考字段：4 张图片、2 个音频、1 个视频

如果您满足以下条件，请使用此工作流程：

  • 是一位重视角色/场景一致性的人工智能电影制作人

  • 希望能够有效地使用 FFLF、无缝扩展视频或使用角色参考表。

  • 想要编辑视频，或复制和使用参考视频中的动作

  • 想要对镜头的视觉效果和音频进行微调控制。

如果您希望生成简单的一次性视频剪辑（例如威尔·史密斯吃意大利面），您可以在此工作流程中切换到的 t2v/i2v 模型将为您做到这一点。

Kijai 的 int8 转换视频 vae：https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors

将您的 Comfort CUDA 版本更新至 13.0。如果您开始感到舒服并看到 cu130：

[信息] pytorch版本：2.13.0+cu130

那么你就可以出发了！但如果您使用 cu126，那么由于舒适的厨房操作效率低下，您所有拥有 Minimax 模型（INT8 转换）最佳版本的一代将比应有的速度慢 2 倍！请记住，如果您更新 cuda，则需要重新安装 Sage Attention！从这里下载正确的车轮https://wildminder.github.io/AI-windows-whl/

所有模型/节点链接都在工作流程注释中，或者可以通过 COMFY-UI 管理器轻松安装。

Please use that instead.

Watch the tutorial video on how to build an anime-style short using this workflow:

A no-nonsense high level T2V / I2V / FFLF / REF2V workflow for Minimax H3 with lots of options & togglable quality of life features.

  • Toggle between the [T2V / I2V / FFLF] model & the [REF2VA] model easily

  • Added Forced Custom Audio: Lipsyncing to custom dialogue/music is now easy for T2V/I2V/REF2VA!

  • Temporal Upsampler 2nd Pass Option! [https://github.com/matlowai/ComfyUI-MAINodes]

  • New Image Loader allows cropping/setting max megapixels directly inside node:https://github.com/obvpm/comfyui-obvpm (Must install via unzipping to custom_nodes folder or through comfy-manager's Install via Git option, it's too new to be on the comfy-manager's index)

  • Kijai's Preview Override (puthttps://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/blob/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensorsin /vae_approx/ and set as the custom vae for non-pixelated previews)

  • Speedup: Sage-Attn + New Sol-Attn [https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton]

  • Speedup node: EasyCache / Spectrum [https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3]

  • Turbo LoRA (t2v/i2v but works with ref2va if you don't mind [some] audio degradation)

    • New (8/11/26) Lightx2v 1.0 release [https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/tree/main]

  • Film VFI Frame Interpolation (24 fps -> 48 fps)

  • Easily togglable reference fields: 4 pictures, 2 audio, 1 video

Use this workflow if you:

  • Are an AI Filmmaker who values character/scene consistency

  • Want to be able to use FFLF effectively, seamlessly extend videos, or use character reference sheets.

  • Want to edit videos, or copy & use motion from reference videos

  • Want fine-tuned control over your shots visuals and audio.

If you wish to generate simple one-off video clips like Will Smith eating spaghetti, the t2v/i2v model that you can toggle to in this workflow will do that for you.

Kijai's int8 convrot video vae:https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors

UPDATE YOUR COMFY CUDA VERSION TO 13.0.If you start comfy and see cu130:

[INFO] pytorch version: 2.13.0+cu130

Then you are good to go! But if you are using cu126, then ALL your gens with the best version of Minimax's model (INT8 convrot) will be 2x slower than they should be due to inefficient comfy-kitchen operations! Keep in mind if you update your cuda, you will need to reinstall Sage Attention! Download the correct wheel from herehttps://wildminder.github.io/AI-windows-whl/

ALL MODEL / NODE LINKS ARE IN THE WORKFLOW NOTES OR EASILY INSTALLABLE THROUGH COMFY-UI MANAGER.
